tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background behind grouped content (iOS systemGroupedBackground). In CarPlay always the dark value.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, Live Activity and widget backgrounds, on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the GPS speed readout, on ground or surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units (km/h), road names, timestamps. 4.5:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows. Never a border around the sign.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: App tint: buttons, links, progress, selected state. Deliberately blue so nothing interactive is ever mistaken for the red sign ring.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Fill for the over-limit pill behind the readout. Always carries on-caution text; never used as text on ground.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on caution.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: Caution as text or icon on surface or ground: stale data, sync failures, over-limit delta label.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Ring of the sign when the limit is unknown (no fix, off the register). 3:1 against white.

tokens.name: sign-face
tokens.usage: Speed sign disc. Identical in every theme: the sign is a road object, not UI.

tokens.name: sign-ring
tokens.usage: Speed sign red ring. Reserved for the sign: never a button, badge, error or alert colour. Approximation; check against the NZTA Traffic Control Devices specification.

tokens.name: sign-ink
tokens.usage: Numerals on sign-face.

tokens.name: island
tokens.usage: Dynamic Island background, always black in both themes.

tokens.name: on-island
tokens.usage: Text in the Dynamic Island.

styles.name: sign-numeral
styles.usage: Numerals inside the sign only. Size is 42% of the sign diameter (36% for three digits). SF Pro Bold, monospaced digits. Fixed: does not scale with Dynamic Type; the sign scales as a whole.

styles.name: speed-readout
styles.usage: Measured GPS speed. SF Pro Rounded Heavy, monospaced digits, so measured speed never looks like a sign. Use .contentTransition(.numericText()).

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Settings and About screens only. Never on the driving screen.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Road name on the driving screen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, Live Activity road name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Limits come from the NZTA National Speed Limit Register.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Data freshness, units under the readout, attribution.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units in compact surfaces (widget, Lock Screen).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a numeral and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label; padding in the Dynamic Island.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked text lines in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row and card padding; Live Activity padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin (iOS standard).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sign and readout on the driving screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Over-limit pill in compact surfaces, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inset grouped lists, over-limit pill on the driving screen.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Live Activity, widget and CarPlay cards (matches system containers; on device use the container shape the system supplies).
